generated_response: Liquidity refers to the ability of an asset to be quickly converted into cash in exchange for other assets or liabilities. In finance, it is often used to describe the degree to which an asset can be sold without significant loss or delay. An asset has good liquidity when it can be easily bought and sold in a market with minimal transaction costs and little risk of default.
